vulnerable_code:
@router.websocket("/ws/v1/telemetry/stream")
async def telemetry_event_stream(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    event_bus: RedisEventBus = Depends(get_event_bus)
):
    await websocket.accept()
    init_msg = await websocket.receive_json()
    carrier = init_msg.get("trace_headers", {})
    ctx = TraceContextTextMapPropagator().extract(carrier)
    token = context.attach(ctx)
    try:
        tenant_id = baggage.get_baggage("tenant_id")
        if not tenant_id:
            await websocket.close(code=4001, reason="Tenant ID missing in trace baggage")
            return

        pubsub = await event_bus.subscribe(f"tenant:{tenant_id}:events")
        async for message in pubsub.listen():
            if message["type"] == "message":
                await websocket.send_text(message["data"])
    finally:
        context.detach(token)
diagnosis: The WebSocket telemetry stream accepts connections and extracts tenant_id from OpenTelemetry trace baggage supplied in the client's initial handshake message. It never performs user authentication or verifies that the caller belongs to tenant_id, allowing unauthorized clients to subscribe to real-time internal event streams of other tenants.
corrected_code:
@router.websocket("/ws/v1/telemetry/stream")
async def telemetry_event_stream(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    event_bus: RedisEventBus = Depends(get_event_bus),
    auth_service: AuthService = Depends(get_auth_service)
):
    await websocket.accept()
    init_msg = await websocket.receive_json()
    auth_token = init_msg.get("auth_token")
    user = await auth_service.validate_token(auth_token)
    if not user:
        await websocket.close(code=4003, reason="Unauthorized")
        return

    carrier = init_msg.get("trace_headers", {})
    ctx = TraceContextTextMapPropagator().extract(carrier)
    token = context.attach(ctx)
    try:
        tenant_id = baggage.get_baggage("tenant_id")
        if not tenant_id or (tenant_id != user.tenant_id and not user.is_platform_admin):
            await websocket.close(code=4003, reason="Forbidden: unauthorized tenant baggage")
            return

        pubsub = await event_bus.subscribe(f"tenant:{tenant_id}:events")
        async for message in pubsub.listen():
            if message["type"] == "message":
                await websocket.send_text(message["data"])
    finally:
        context.detach(token)
